title: Understanding Bimodal Distribution
text: A bimodal distribution has two different modes, or peaks. Look at the distribution of weights for each shape. Do you see two distinct peaks in any of them?

title: Using Overlaid Histograms
text: Overlaid histograms can help visualize the distribution of data by showing multiple datasets on the same plot. This can make it easier to compare the distributions and identify features like bimodality.
